[SWS_DM_01031] Notification about UDS DTC status changes
⌈
If the
AA has registered for a UDS DTC status change notification via the function ara::-
diag::DTCInformation::SetDTCStatusChangedNotifier of the correspond-
ing ara::diag::DTCInformation instance, the DM shall call this notifier on any
UDS DTC status change for every single DTC mapped to this fault memory.
⌋
